accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.intro: Expenses, cash book and profit. Buying stock is not an expense: it is recorded in Purchasing and reaches profit when the goods are sold.

dialog.amountInvalid: Enter an amount above zero, for example 1500 or 1500.50
dialog.fromTillHint: Lowers the cash your open shift should hold. Leave it off for cash paid from the safe or office.

void.title: Void expense {docNo}
void.explain: The expense stays in the list marked void with your reason. It is no longer counted in totals.

categories.intro: Categories group expenses in reports. Rename or hide them as you like. A category with past expenses is hidden, never deleted.

cashBook.title: Cash book
cashBook.floatNote: Shift floats move between the safe and the till. They are not income or expense.
cashBook.note: Opening cash is everything taken in cash minus everything paid out in cash before the first day. It starts from zero on the day the system was first used.

profit.title: Profit and loss
profit.note: Net profit = revenue without tax (after returns) - cost of goods sold - expenses. Purchases of stock are not subtracted: they become cost when the goods are sold.

entries.title: Cash book entries
entries.hint: Enter the opening balance once, on the day you start tracking cash. Use an adjustment to correct the cash or to record money the owner puts in or takes out.
